sentences.text:
The present petition is filed seeking quashing of Fir No. 432/2023 dated 09.06.2023 registered
at Police Station Dayal Pur under Sections 498A/406/506/376/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,
on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes.

2.  The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State, at the outset, submits that serious allegations have been made against one of the accused persons who happens to be the Brother-in-Law of the complainant.
3.
He seeks time to file a reply.

4. Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
5. List on 01.10.2024.
